test_deprecated_day_attrs: test that deprecated PeriodIndex attributes dayofweek, dayofyear, daysinmonth produce Pandas4Warning and match new attribute names
test_start_time: test that PeriodIndex.start_time returns a DatetimeIndex with frequency MS covering the same period range
test_end_time: test that PeriodIndex.end_time returns a DatetimeIndex with frequency ME plus one day minus one microsecond
test_end_time_business_friday: test that PeriodIndex.end_time with business day frequency returns the correct end datetime
test_period_range_creation: test creating a PeriodIndex via period_range with start, end, and frequency parameters
